The studio

Learning that makes sense

Talíno is a tutoring and academic-review studio in Baguio City, for students who are bright but stuck — the ones who just need a subject explained a different way, by someone with the time to do it.

"Talíno" means cleverness, and we believe every student has it; our job is to clear away the confusion around it. We keep classes small, match tutors to the way a student learns, and work alongside their school topics instead of against them.

It's a calm, encouraging place — no shouting, no shame for a wrong answer. Just steady progress a parent can actually see.

Programs

What we teach

Matched to your child's year level and the way they learn best.

PROG 01

After-school tutoring

Homework help and subject support for grade-school and high-school students, reinforcing what they're covering in class.

PROG 02

Subject specialists

Focused help in the subjects that trip students up most — Math, Science, English and Filipino — from tutors who love them.

PROG 03

College-entrance review

Structured review for senior-high students preparing for university entrance tests, with practice and strategy.

PROG 04

Small-group classes

Capped group sessions where students learn together, ask freely, and keep each other motivated.

PROG 05

One-to-one tutoring

Fully personalised sessions for students who need closer support or want to move at their own pace.

PROG 06

Study skills & online

Coaching in note-taking, revision and exam technique — available in the studio or online.

Inside the studio

A look around

For parents

Questions

What ages and levels do you teach? +
We tutor grade-school and high-school students across core subjects, and run college-entrance review for senior high students. Sessions are matched to each student's grade level and pace.
How big are your classes? +
Small by design — group sessions are capped so every student gets attention, and one-to-one tutoring is available when a student needs closer support. We'd rather keep classes small than fill a room.
Are your tutors qualified teachers? +
Yes. Our tutors include Licensed Professional Teachers and subject specialists, and every tutor is screened and follows our child-safety policy.
Do you follow the school curriculum? +
We align with the DepEd curriculum and, where helpful, coordinate with a student's own school topics — so tutoring reinforces class work rather than pulling against it.
Do you offer online sessions? +
We do. Sessions can be in person at our Session Road studio or online, and some families mix the two around school and travel.
How do you track progress? +
We assess at the start, set clear goals with the family, and share regular notes on what's improving and what to work on next — so you always know where your child stands.
How do we enrol? +
Message or call us for a short chat about your child's year level, subjects and goals. We'll suggest a schedule and start with a friendly assessment session.
